source_note: AWeber publishes OpenAPI 3.0.2 across 34 files at api.aweber.com (swagger.yaml plus _tags/_paths/_parameters/_responses/_definitions and 12 per-resource path files, plus doc-only tag files). All were fetched and bundled into openapi/_original/aweber-api-openapi.yml with external $refs resolved and nothing else changed.
warnings: The published spec assigns an operationId to only 1 of 57 operations; the refined per-tag specs carry operationIds derived from AWeber's own summaries, recorded in overlays/aweber-api-overlay.yaml.
Several published path keys carry a query string (?ws.op=find, ?ws.op=getActivity) - AWeber's named-operation convention, preserved verbatim.
notes: Replaced a prior best-effort scaffold spec (18 fabricated operations, including a /accounts/{accountId}/landing_pages path that does not exist) with the provider's real published contract.
